# AnswerLens

AnswerLens audits the public evidence layer of B2B SaaS websites and turns visible gaps into source-backed validation, monitoring, recovery, or implementation reports.

## Canonical URL
https://app.sfdj.net

## Audience
B2B software founders, marketers, and operators evaluating whether public website evidence can be cited and summarized by search and answer engines.

## Product
AnswerLens checks public website crawlability, metadata, proof surfaces, comparison coverage, buyer question coverage, freshness, and implementation gaps.

## Public Commercial Terms
Free public evidence reports cost $0. Paid evidence reports are one-time digital purchases for $79 USD. The paid output may be a validation brief, monitoring baseline, technical recovery check, or implementation-ready report depending on evidence quality. Refund exceptions are reviewed manually under the public refund policy.

## Access Notes
Admin, report detail, and API routes are private or restricted. Public crawlers should use the homepage and sitemap only.
